items.ruling_applied: D31-B7; D31-B13; manual R3 (FDC as one agent)
items.reason: 'Nivolumab + Relatlimab FDC' is given only in Part 2 Cohort 3, not in every arm, and the record does not make it established standard care of the registered population ('advanced and/or metastatic solid tumor malignancy with homozygous deletion of the MTAP gene'); under D31-B7/B13 an approved drug fixed in some arms whose dose is not studied is a candidate (experimental_combination), its two FDC components split per manual C4. Moot for analysis because the trial fails S5.

items.coder_A: Solid-tumour basket; GBM is named only in keywords (not conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels), but a temozolomide + radiotherapy cohort and RANO v2 response criteria strongly imply an eligible GBM cohort. Would be basket_gbm_eligible if this were accepted.
items.reason: Conditions are 'Solid Tumors' and inclusion is 'advanced and/or metastatic solid tumor malignancy with homozygous deletion of the MTAP gene'; GBM appears only in keywords ('Brain cancer; GBM'), and the Cohort 4 label 'BMS-986504 + Temozolomide + Radiotherapy' does not name glioblastoma. C7 says keywords do not make a trial eligible even if they imply a GBM cohort.

note: Near-miss (D31-B5): GBM named only in keywords ('Brain cancer; GBM'); fails S5 (not_glioblastoma), so the candidate set does not reach the analysis. Nivolumab/relatlimab FDC now candidates (experimental_combination) under D31-B7/B13 (medium; outcome-neutral). Basket false because GBM is not eligible (coders split, priority 3). tumour_pk 'unclear' per W7 (PK planned, sample type not stated).

revisions.reason: The nivolumab + relatlimab FDC is fixed in Cohort 3 only and is not shown by the record to be established standard care of the MTAP-deleted solid-tumour population, so it is a candidate under D31-B7/B13.
Adds nivolumab and relatlimab (components of the Cohort 3 FDC) as experimental_combination, consistent with the candidate_set item.
